nodes_reduced.why: the clusters that satisfy its requires have 2 node(s): sched-eks-cpu-efa-bigmem, sched-gke-bigmem, sched-gke-cpu

scaled_down.why: up to 4KB and 10 iterations: enough to prove the collective works

Artifact:
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: metric-osu-cpu-job-0191
spec:
  size: 2
  tasks: 0
  flux:
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-ubuntu:jammy
      pullAlways: true
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/metric-osu-cpu:libfabric
      launcher: true
      command: "flux-secretary run --nodes 2 --attempts 10 --model us.anthropic.claude-opus-5 -- /opt/osu-benchmark/build.openmpi/libexec/osu-micro-benchmarks/mpi/collective/osu_allreduce -m 8:4096 -i 10 -f"
      commands:
        pre: |
          /mnt/flux/view/bin/python3.14 -m ensurepip
          /mnt/flux/view/bin/python3.14 -m pip install --no-cache-dir flux-secretary[all]
      volumes:
        secretary-token:
          path: /etc/flux-secretary
          secretName: flux-secretary-token
